text:
sophie: bump to 10% just showed a subtle p95 uptick (baseline ~90ms -> 180ms). holding traffic at 10% for now. @dan @liam can you eyeball infra + model side?

dan: seeing it too. errors are flat but p95 tail moved. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~2%. no obvious 5xx spike.

ops-bot: ALERT: service api-edge-eu p95 latency > 150ms across 5m window. No automatic rollback configured for this rollout.

sophie: OK hold — do not proceed to 30%. liam, is model version pinned for the canary? any changes to cache keys?

liam: model is pinned to v2.1-quant (rolled from v2.0). no intentional cache-key schema changes. reproducing a short load test in staging now.

sophie: deploy-bot, can you pause the percent rollout and prepare a rollback plan? we want minimal customer impact.

deploy-bot: Received command: `/deploy pause --rollout 1732123456` — rollout paused at 10%. No active automated rollback. Awaiting explicit rollback instruction.

dan: if rollback is heavy, we could route small percent to fallback region (ap-south) while debugging. but simpler to pin back to v2.0.

liam: i vote rollback -> v2.0. i'll continue digging into kvcache TTLs and model kv-cache compatibility.

sophie: agreed. initiating rollback to v2.0 now. deploy-bot, please run rollback 100% to v2.0 and include reason 'p95 spike during canary'.

deploy-bot: Received command: `/deploy rollback --to v2.0 --shift 100% --reason "p95 spike during canary"` — starting rollback. ETA ~2m. Streaming status...

ops-bot: Incident created: staged-rollout-latency-1732123456. Paging oncall @pager_duty.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: shifting traffic -> v2.0 (50%)... 100% complete. Cutover recorded at 1732123650.

liam: metrics confirming baseline returning. p95 back to ~95ms, KV hit-rate recovered. collecting logs for postmortem.

sophie: thanks. i'll draft a brief release-note revert entry: "revert v2.1-quant due to p95 regression in EU canary" and schedule a retro. we will not resume rollout until kvcache mismatch hypothesis is validated and a staging warmup of 2h passes.

dan: noted. tagging relnotes and ops runbook. :thumbsup:

sophie: closing this checkcall — if anyone sees residual anomalies, flag in #incidents.
